description: Summary figures: paralog cavity scan and ortholog conservation of the NHR-47 insertion
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
panel=pd.DataFrame([
 ('nhr-69',425,1.81),('nhr-49',256,1.34),('daf-12',279,1.09),('nhr-8',197,1.43),
 ('nhr-64',239,0.64),('nhr-40',171,0.51),('nhr-25',90,-0.49),('nhr-48',61,1.61),
 ('nhr-23',1053,-0.74),('nhr-14',0,np.nan),('nhr-47',0,np.nan)],columns=['gene','vol','KD'])
panel=panel.sort_values('vol',ascending=False)
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,4.8))
ax=axes[0]
cols=['#c1121f' if g=='nhr-47' else ('#e9c46a' if g=='nhr-14' else '#2a6f97') for g in panel.gene]
ax.barh(range(len(panel)),panel.vol,color=cols)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(panel))); ax.set_yticklabels(panel.gene,fontsize=9); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlabel('Largest enclosed cavity in LBD (cubic Angstrom)')
ax.set_title('Uniform cavity scan, 11 C. elegans nuclear receptors\n(AlphaFold, residues with pLDDT >= 70, LBD only)',fontsize=10)
for i,v in enumerate(panel.vol):
    ax.text(v+15,i,'none detected' if v==0 else f'{v:g}',va='center',fontsize=8)
for v,lab in [(472,'HNF4g holo'),(162,'HNF4a holo')]:
    ax.axvline(v,ls='--',lw=0.9,color='grey'); ax.text(v,-0.85,lab,fontsize=7,color='grey',ha='center')
ax.set_xlim(0,1250)

ax=axes[1]
sp=['C. briggsae','C. remanei','C. latens','C. nigoni','C. brenneri','C. tropicalis','C. bovis',
    'C. auriculariae','D. pachys','A. ceylanicum','S. hermaphroditum','D. viviparus']
core=[94.7,94.7,94.7,94.7,93.8,91.4,82.7,79.6,76.3,69.8,68.9,68.4]
pock=[85.0,85.0,90.0,84.2,90.0,68.4,84.2,84.2,70.0,75.0,61.1,75.0]
insv=[72.1,73.6,73.6,70.7,73.4,80.3,55.8,52.0,42.0,44.1,27.4,39.7]
x=np.arange(len(sp)); w=0.27
ax.bar(x-w,core,w,label='LBD core (141-255, 440-550)',color='#2a6f97')
ax.bar(x,pock,w,label='20 pocket-equivalent positions',color='#5fa8d3')
ax.bar(x+w,insv,w,label='insertion (258-435)',color='#e76f51')
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(sp,rotation=55,ha='right',fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel('% identity to C. elegans NHR-47'); ax.set_ylim(0,100); ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc='upper right')
ax.set_title('The 178-residue insertion is present and alignable in every\nnhr-47 homolog found, including non-Caenorhabditis nematodes',fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(panel.to_string(index=False))
print("\nNHR-47 and nhr-14 are the only 2 of 11 worm NHRs with no cavity >=50 cubic A under the uniform protocol.")
print("Median cavity of the other 9: %.0f cubic A; median lining Kyte-Doolittle %.2f"%(panel[panel.vol>0].vol.median(),panel[panel.vol>0].KD.median()))
